show.title: Mirzapur
show.synopsis: The iron-fisted Akhandanand Tripathi is a carpet exporter and the undisputed mafia don of Mirzapur. His ambitious, power-hungry son Munna stops at nothing to inherit his father's legacy, until an altercation with two upright brothers, Guddu and Bablu, triggers a bloody turf war that engulfs the Purvanchal underworld.

recaps.storyRecap: Welcome to Mirzapur, where Kaleen Bhaiya rules with an iron grip. His hot-headed son Munna crashes a wedding, accidentally kills the groom with celebratory gunfire, and threatens local lawyer Ramakant Pandit. When Ramakant's sons Guddu and Bablu beat Munna to a pulp, Kaleen Bhaiya summons them — and rather than killing them, offers them a job in his arms trade.

Guddu & Bablu overpower Munna and his goons at their home

recaps.storyRecap: The catastrophic turning point of Mirzapur. Munna's resentment boils over after Kaleen Bhaiya appears to favor Guddu and Bablu. In Gorakhpur at a wedding, Munna arrives with machine guns. In a horrifying massacre, Munna ruthlessly executes Bablu Pandit and pregnant Sweety in front of Guddu. Guddu, shot and crippled in the leg, barely manages to escape with Golu and Dimpy.

recaps.storyRecap: Guddu has spent months healing his shattered knee and training relentlessly with Golu in an isolated safehouse. Rather than directly charging the Tripathi fortress, they hit Kaleen Bhaiya's supply chains, hijacking opium consignments. Meanwhile, Munna is politically married to widow Madhuri Yadav by Kaleen Bhaiya to lock in state protection, while Beena secretly sends intel to Guddu.

recaps.storyRecap: The Season 2 climax at the burning ghats! Guddu and Golu orchestrate an all-out assault as Kaleen Bhaiya and Munna perform funeral rites. Surrounded and outgunned, Munna is gunned down in a hail of bullets by Guddu and Golu, avenging Bablu and Sweety. As Guddu prepares to deliver the fatal bullet to a bleeding Kaleen Bhaiya, Sharad Shukla speeds in and rescues Kaleen away. Guddu limps into the Tripathi mansion and sits on the throne.

recaps.storyRecap: The explosive finale of Season 3! CM Madhuri Yadav uses state power to crack down on all Purvanchal syndicates. Sharad Shukla gathers the regional dons for the grand coronation to be declared the undisputed Don of Purvanchal. Just as Sharad is about to be crowned, Kaleen Bhaiya reappears in a stunning reveal and shoots Sharad dead! Meanwhile, Golu breaks Guddu out of jail in a daring high-octane escape.
